predecessors.name: Mayapan
predecessors.text: 'Chikinchel was a Mayan chiefdom on the northern coast of the Yucatán'; the page gives bounds, not a centre

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: 'Chikinchel was a Mayan chiefdom on the northern coast of the Yucatán'; the page gives bounds, not a centre

ledger.x: 1441: 'After the destruction of Mayapan (1441-1461)... it created rivalries among the Maya' and the 16 Kuchkabals; the page gives no date for Chikinchel itself (bridge).

1546: 'In late 1546 an alliance of eastern provinces launched an unsuccessful uprising against the Spanish', which 'marked the final conquest of the northern portion of the Yucatán Peninsula'; the pages do not name Chikinchel in the uprising or give its own conquest date.

certainty.note: The page gives neighbours but no frontier.
